text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
Premises:
MountainRange(picuris, newMexico) ∨ MountainRange(picuris, texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, picuris) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x, texas) ∧ ∃y (LocatedIn(y, x) ∧ Donated(y))) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, newMexico) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is not located in a mountain range in New Mexico.
